desc: The Ruger Mark IV Air Pistol will turn your backyard into a range, providing you with hours of target practice fun. A replica of the fourth-generation successor to the original Ruger Standard, the airgun has a single-shot, break-barrel design. It has a rifled barrel that’s ideal for .177 caliber pellets and a combination of smooth and checkered grip panels. The airgun has a smooth, single-stage trigger, a manual and automatic thumb safety, a fully adjustable rear sight and a fixed front, fiber optic sight. Lightweight and easy to use, the Ruger Mark IV Air Pistol is perfect for target shooting and plinking.
